opaqueShapes.name: NamedKeys
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Borrowed named-key bit storage; actual ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN <= key < END.

opaqueShapes.name: TableSettings
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Borrowed chunk ordinal iteration via begin/next_chunk; invalidate on stream mutation.

opaqueShapes.name: WindowSettings
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Borrowed chunk ordinal iteration via begin/next_chunk; invalidate on stream mutation.

opaqueShapes.name: DrawListSharedData
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Borrowed context/draw-list shared state; copied scalar snapshot only.

opaqueShapes.name: FileHandle
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Pointer-valued borrowed file; no close. Native failure may leave position moved.

opaqueShapes.name: MultiSelectPool
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Map iteration skips tombstones; invalidate before add/remove/reserve/clear.

opaqueShapes.name: TabBarPool
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Map iteration skips tombstones; invalidate before add/remove/reserve/clear.

opaqueShapes.name: TablePool
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Map iteration skips tombstones; invalidate before add/remove/reserve/clear.

opaqueShapes.name: CellSpan
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Borrowed backing array; invalidate before backing destruction/reallocation or span rebinding.

opaqueShapes.name: ColumnSpan
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Borrowed native column indexing; derived record accesses retain scope.

opaqueShapes.name: ShortSpan
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Borrowed backing array; copied short value, never a managed Size1 stride.

opaqueShapes.name: BakedVector
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Real block indexing; growth retains addresses natively, clear/destruction invalidates. No component ownership/destruction.

opaqueShapes.name: TextEditState
opaqueShapes.lifetime: Real configured ImStb header definition; borrowed input-text lifetime, no replacement editor algorithm.
